caption: Louis Franchet d'Espèrey (1856–1942), 'Desperate Frankie' to the British — led I Corps at Guise, replaced Lanrezac at the head of the 5th Army on 3 September, and drove into the gap beside the BEF at the Marne; commanded the Salonika breakthrough in 1918. Colorized (AI-assisted) from a public-domain photograph; the horizon-blue uniform post-dates 1914.
